design: Test one causal hypothesis before authoring: current linear skinning may compress the fitted source garment at the elbow. Compare untouched V18 cloth with Blender preserve-volume skinning at the same three poses, leaving original skin linear, topology/UV/weights/rest geometry/rig/camera unchanged. Only change the garment modifier boolean in memory; no native save or render for this diagnosis. Evaluate local inner-elbow gap, actual surfaces and source geometry quality. Do not assume dual-quaternion deformation fixes fit or can be exported directly to current runtime.
diagnostic_decision: Cloth-only DQ rejected: hip deficits17-to17 and ADS23-to25; sampled inner-elbow signed gaps worsen by up to8.82mm. Source file was not saved.

transport_candidate.source: Untouched V18 Basis, original source skin triangle IDs and barycentric coordinates from surface-transfer.json
transport_candidate.domain: Original609-vertex/582-quad pure-left-arm sleeve component; fixed54 boundary vertices
transport_candidate.falloff: One fixed four-edge-ring support around the seven measured negative-radial inner-elbow witnesses, also zero at either boundary; quintic smootherstep of min(1-core_distance/4,boundary_distance/4,1). No ring search.
transport_candidate.transport: Fixed barycentric surface point plus complete original tangent/normal offset rotated by orthonormal rest-to-posed source triangle frame and world scale.0744. No triangle shear/scale transfer or new posed correspondence.
transport_candidate.pose_keys: Separate hip and ADS inverse-LBS rest correctives, one active at each endpoint; reload Basis. Any intermediate test uses partition-of-unity key weights and interpolated original bones.
transport_candidate.acceptance: Preflight is not art acceptance. Actual Blender tessellation, unchanged boundary/topology/UV/weights/skin, all450 local points, crossings, six views and two fixed50% intermediate states must be checked. If the one candidate fails quality, close the recipe without varying triangle correspondence, offset amount or rings.

gates: LBS baseline matches archived V18 evaluated vertices and triangles exactly
Original skin matches archived V17 in every pose under either cloth modifier state
No source file changes, topology/UV/weight edits, skin masking, capped openings or retopology
Report signed nearest-surface distances as local diagnostics, not containment proof
Use actual Blender evaluated triangles for any crossing audit
No runtime promotion without a separately verified deform/export strategy and six-view visual evidence
